reason: D-0012: Gate A (check_pr_ticket) accepts a story added-and-completed in one PR (base-absent -> head-done + history)

quality.summary: Minimal, correct one-condition change: completed_stories now accepts base-absent OR not-done-at-base, keeping the done-at-head and history-added requirements. Failure message updated to name the addition case. A direct non-parametrized test (base-absent + done + history passes) plus the existing six check_pr_ticket tests green.

performance.summary: No performance impact — the same single-pass set comprehension over head_items with an altered boolean condition. No new I/O, no new git calls.

security.summary: Does not weaken Gate A. Accepting base-absent still requires all the real evidence: the story is on the roadmap and done AT HEAD, its .factory/history/<key>/ archive is ADDED in this PR's diff, and a ticket candidate (branch feat/<key>- or a Ticket: line) resolves to it. A bundled add+complete PR is a legitimate completion; faking it would require fabricating the whole history archive, which is what the evidence recorders protect. Exactly-one-record resolution is unchanged.
